prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the poster template, create a new version for Kunming while preserving the same vintage morning poster layout, aged paper texture, ink gaps, halftone erosion, thin border grime, diagonal hairline, small issue/page metadata blocks, bottom quotation placement, and calm minimalist composition.

Transform the main location identity: replace the large central Chinese city characters with 昆明, set in the same oversized blocky distressed typographic style, but shift the ink color from rusty red to warm golden ochre. Update the small top-left city label from BEIJING to KUNMING, and change the weather line to WEATHER 晴 / 云淡. Keep the date as 2026-08-07 unless customized.

Change the lower scenery from the Beijing city-wall scene into a Kunming lakeside promenade: replace the cyclist with exactly 1 walking pedestrian, add exactly 1 tall streetlamp on the left, add a low waterfront railing with evenly spaced posts, calm pale green-blue water with reflections, and a small traditional pavilion with blooming pink-white trees on the right. Include a few tiny birds in the sky and a few white birds on the water, kept subtle and sparse.

Update the bottom metadata to read KUNMING, CHINA and adjust the city index coordinates for Kunming. Replace the bottom quote with 四季如春，也要日日新鲜. Maintain the same quiet Chinese editorial poster aesthetic, muted palette, large empty sky area, risograph/letterpress grain, worn edges, and no modern photorealism.
